location: Twist and Shout railroad-bridge take-out, Tygart Valley River, West Virginia
coordinateInterpretation: American Whitewater exact take-out coordinate beneath an active railroad bridge; access-area anchor, not surveyed wet-toe coordinate.
accessCondition: Confirm current legal land access, parking, carry path, bridge-area restrictions, and any gates before launching. Never walk the active railroad line.

evidence.claim: American Whitewater identifies the Twist and Shout take-out under the railroad bridge and publishes 39.40187, -80.09554, exactly matching the stored route coordinate.
Current route guidance warns that the lower take-out is below an active railroad bridge and requires a separate shuttle plan; the state park confirms kayaking is available at Valley Falls.
evidence.sourceType: state park activity and access context

evidence.claim: American Whitewater historical reports document past changes to gates and take-out access, so current legal access cannot be assumed from the coordinate alone.
The endpoint was 484 feet from the named Tygart Valley River flowline but within 2 feet of Glady Creek and had complete hydrography coverage before source review.
